races.paceDynamic: The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria, and Suerte all want prominent positions, creating a false pace scenario with four horses vying for the same tactical spot. This congestion will likely cause traffic problems turning for home as hold-up horses Benavente, Una Matata, Ruff Justice, and Crest Of Light need room to mount their challenges in what should become a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Liffey or Dontspoilasale secure an uncontested lead from the crowded prominent brigade
scenarios.body: The winner gets first run from the front while the other three prominent horses interfere with each other. Hold-up horses find the gap too big to close in the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent horses create a messy pace battle and leave gaps for closers
scenarios.body: Una Matata and Benavente get perfect splits through the faltering prominent horses turning for home. The pace collapse allows the hold-up brigade to sweep past tired leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Going Dependent Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the Good going plays faster than expected, favoring front-running tactics
scenarios.body: Thaloria overcomes recent poor form to lead throughout while going-dependent horses Benavente and Ruff Justice fail to handle the conditions. The pace stays strong enough to hold off late challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes severe interference problems turning for home
scenarios.body: Crest Of Light finds the clearest passage wide of the trouble while higher-rated horses get stopped in their runs. The winner emerges from the pack at long odds due to positioning luck.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems at the 2-3 furlong marker as four hold-up horses need room simultaneously behind the prominent quartet
Monitor how The Liffey and Dontspoilasale settle early as both need to avoid getting drawn into pace battle with Thaloria and Suerte
Check if Benavente travels smoothly in the early stages as going-dependent horses often show their hand before the turn
Observe Thaloria's finishing kick as this horse has recent form of winning then fading badly when conditions don't suit
Watch Crest Of Light's positioning wide throughout as this represents the best chance of avoiding the expected trouble

races.paceDynamic: Spinning Around is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms without early pressure, allowing her to set a sustainable gallop. The prominent trio of Bishopton, Musical Act, and Venetian will track closely behind, while four hold-up horses (Blue Anthem, Um Wadi, Nikki Swango, Whistling Jamesie) must rely on the pace collapsing or finding racing room late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Spinning Around Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Spinning Around gets uncontested lead and sustains kick
scenarios.body: She dictates fractions perfectly and has enough left to resist late challengers. The hold-up brigade arrives too late as the pace never truly collapses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Cooker
scenarios.trigger: If Bishopton and Musical Act press Spinning Around from early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo up front sets up perfectly for the closers with stamina. Blue Anthem and Nikki Swango (if going suits) arrive with devastating late runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Problems
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses but hold-up horses get blocked
scenarios.body: Spinning Around and the prominent runners maintain their advantage as closers struggle for clear runs. Musical Act or Venetian capitalizes on the tactical race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Whistling Jamesie Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is moderate and Whistling Jamesie gets perfect trip
scenarios.body: His recent Dundalk win gives confidence and he finds the gaps that others miss. The form pick capitalizes on ideal positioning and race flow.

watchPoints.text: Um Wadi and Whistling Jamesie both fade late regularly - avoid if they're prominent in betting
Nikki Swango's going dependency could be crucial factor if track conditions differ from reported
Musical Act's position tracking Spinning Around will determine if pace becomes competitive early
Blue Anthem needs clear sight of Spinning Around weakening to unleash his proven closing kick
Venetian's stamina questions at 7f after string of shorter trips could expose her late on

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Wind will take the field along as the lone confirmed front runner, with Jazzy Dancer, Comfort Line, Manhattan Dandy and Carrickfinn providing some early company but likely settling just behind. The sustainable early gallop will create a tactical affair where the 10+ hold-up horses bunch together in mid-pack, setting up a cavalry charge finish where stamina and positioning become crucial over this 7f trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind sets honest but not punishing fractions and the hold-up brigade get clear runs
scenarios.body: The patient rides on Winemaker, Jasmine Affanalis and Roman Harry pay dividends as they sweep past tiring leaders. Fresh legs from deep prove decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Wind and the prominent racers open up significant daylight turning for home
scenarios.body: Jazzy Dancer and Comfort Line capitalize on their forward positions while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. The early pace proves sustainable enough for those who stayed handy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Finish Traffic Issues
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates a wall of traffic in the home straight
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get hampered or forced wide, allowing a horse with a cleaner passage to capitalize. Positioning luck becomes the decisive factor over raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going Changes Mid Race
scenarios.trigger: If the good going deteriorates or proves more testing than expected during the race
scenarios.body: Going-dependent horses Son Of Wind and Vibrato struggle while those proven on varying surfaces like Winemaker thrive. The surface change exposes those reliant on specific conditions.

watchPoints.text: Son Of Wind's going dependency is critical - if the good ground doesn't suit he could fold quickly leaving no pace

Jasmine Affanalis, Roman Harry and Vibrato all show tendencies to fade in finish which is concerning over 7f
